overview: Students can choose from bachelor s programmes focused on international business, sales management, and strategic leadership. Depending on the institution, students may earn a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), a Bachelor and Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration, or a Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration.

faq.question: Can international students study International Business in Finland in English?
faq.answer: Yes. Finnish institutions such as Aalto University, the University of Oulu, Haaga-Helia, HAMK, and the University of Eastern Finland offer relevant English-taught programmes. The exact qualification and admission requirements differ by institution.

faq.question: Can I work in Finland after completing an International Business degree?
faq.answer: Graduates can explore relevant employment opportunities in multinational trade, export, consulting, and management, subject to job availability and current immigration rules. Practical experience, professional networking, and Finnish language skills improve career prospects.
